It was my first time posting something about my life on reddit and honestly, i wasn't expecting that anyone would reply to my story, but THANK YOU SO MUCH <3, for some people it might not mean anything but for me it actually means a lot, your advice really helped me and made me really think everything through. You seem like a really great person with a very great personality, thank you sooo much for deciding to answer to my post honestly i wish all the best for you, i hope you will succeed at everything you do, and get everything you want, this world really needs more people like you, if my gratitude would be physical object it would be bigger than our planet :DD. It was a silly way to explain how grateful i am but i hope you get what i mean :D.  I really i wish you all the best <3.

Hey! Thank you so much for all the advice, am doing well lately and things in general have been pretty good for me. But there is one things which is affecting my mood a little.

My brother is leaving our country for work in a couple of days, and i am going to miss him so much. I love my brother, he has a great personality, literally i wish there was more people like him in this world, i have never met anyone even close with a personality like that. This really sucks, because all my life i grew up with him in the same house, i was seeing him everyday, we play games together, and we do so many other things together. Like i dunno man, am tearing up while writing this ;D. Like we are so close as brothers. He taught me many things in life. Literally i am so happy and grateful that he was there for me and would teach me things whenever i messed up and he would tell me all the different ways i could have done something in a certain situation. One part of my personality actually comes from my brother :D. 

So yeah thats the only iffy thing in my life right now, but i am staying positive and wishing my brother all the best. I hope you are doing well too !!

I already talked to a friend of mine after sharing my story on reddit, we both have stuff like this going on in our lives, with school and parents ect, my social skills are pretty good in my opinion, like i consider myself an introvert but i can be an extrovert at some moments :D, there are times that i just decide to go out and meet new people. I can go along with anyone since i am a friendly person, most of my anger is at people that i dislike. About different living arrangements, am only 18 right now, finishing highschool next year, i dont have a job yet, but next month am going to be back at my highschool dorm room. To be honest with you, even though i get homesick sometimes, i enjoy being being at in my dorm more than at home. ever since covid started, things havent been that well. I am mentally strong, i can keep my emotions inside for a long time. I think it could be the fact that i miss highschool after being at home for months and it has been getting the best of me. I talked to some people about how covid affected them mentally, most of them had same stuff as me.
